annotations.title: Screen a person for PEP status (paid)

description: Use when you must check whether a person is a politically exposed person (PEP) for AML/KYC: heads of state and government, ministers of every country, central bank governors, MEPs and national MPs of the EU, EEA, UK, US and Switzerland, current or former (default 5 years). Fuzzy matching with positions, country and dates. Pairs with sanctions screening. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.
name: pep_screen
